title: cheilanthes pteridioides subsp. guanchica
intro: Cheilanthes pteridioides subsp. guanchica, commonly known as the Canary Island maidenhair fern, is a species of fern native to the Canary Islands. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its health benefits, including its ability to treat digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin conditions. Cheilanthes pteridioides subsp. guanchica is said to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
